title: Guardrail required.
officialText:
A guardrail meeting the requirements of Section 3308.7.1 through Section 3308.7.7 shall be
provided on all open sides of platforms located more than 5 feet (1524 mm) above the ground or floor. For the purposes of this
section the term “floor” in Sections 3308.7.1 through 3308.7.7 shall mean “platform.”
Exception: In lieu of a guardrail, the side of the platform used for the loading or unloading of vehicles may be protected by a
timber curb at least 8 inches by 8 inches (203 mm by 203 mm) for motor trucks or 4 inches by 4 inches (102 mm by 102 mm)
for wheelbarrows and hand-trucks.
